_about: Acetone (1) + Furfural (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetone, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetone, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Y. Ma, J. Gao, M. Li, Z. Zhu, Y. Wang, Isobaric vapour-liquid equilibrium measurements and extractive distillation process for the azeotrope of (N,N-dimethylisopropylamine  +  acetone), J. Chem. Thermodyn. 122 (2018) 154-161
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 11, 12. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0081. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.57 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
